import { html, styled } from 'tamagui'

<html.button
  px="4"
  py="2"
  rounded="4"
  bg="blue-9 hover:blue-10"
>
  <html.span color="white">Ship it</html.span>
</html.button>

// or lift it into a component
const Button = styled(html.button, {
  px: '4',
  py: '2',
  rounded: '4',
  bg: {
    default: 'blue-9',
    hover: 'blue-10',
  },
})
